title: Reworked main() emits sprites.json order that breaks the renderer's positional texture↔bbox pairing on regen
evidence:
tools/gen_sprites.py:327-331:
    build_flat("small_biz", SMALL_BIZ_FILL, SMALL_BIZ_SIZE, 1.20); names.append("small_biz")
    build_flat("campus", CAMPUS_FILL, CAMPUS_SIZE, 1.95); names.append("campus")
    for ports in (4, 8, 16):
        build_puck(ports, "puck_%d" % {4: 1, 8: 2, 16: 3}[ports])
        names.append("puck_%d" % {4: 1, 8: 2, 16: 3}[ports])

app/render/sprites.odin:51-53 (textures loaded positionally):
	files := [SPRITE_COUNT]string{
		"house_0", "house_1", "house_2", "house_3", "host", "dc",
		"puck_1", "puck_2", "puck_3", "small_biz", "campus",
	}

app/render/sprites.odin:106-119 (bboxes bound from sprites.json order[], by name, no files[] cross-check):
		name, okn := order[i].(json.String)
...
			sh.bboxes[i][k] = f32(n)

committed assets/sprites/sprites.json order (matches the renderer): ['house_0', 'house_1', 'house_2', 'house_3', 'host', 'dc', 'puck_1', 'puck_2', 'puck_3', 'small_biz', 'campus']
detail: New emission order puts small_biz/campus at indices 6-7 and pucks at 8-10. On regen, bboxes[i]=content_bbox[order[i]] mis-pairs every texture from index 6 up; sprite_puck_target's base sh.bboxes[6][2] also becomes small_biz's width. Value-range checks pass — silent wrong crops, and the T2 re-bless would bless them. 'Zero renderer code churn' claim holds only if order is preserved.
recommended_fix: Restore the pinned order: append small_biz/campus AFTER the puck loop (as the old main() did), or make sprites_parse_boxes verify order[i] equals files[i]. Also fix assets/blender/README.md:32 which lists the same wrong order.

title: The two normative render-contract tables disagree 2× on the outline ring width
evidence:
assets/blender/README.md:26:
| Outline | thin dark ink `#33414F` plate at the base, footprint + ~0.03 (≈2px in-game ring) |

docs/silhouette-spec.md:29:
| Outline | thin dark ink plate `#33414F` at base, footprint + ~0.06 (≈2px in-game ring) | MM's defining edge |

tools/gen_sprites.py:78:
OUTLINE_RING = 0.03   # ink ring width around the fill (scene units, ~2px in-game)

tools/gen_sprites.py:179:
    add_cube(name + "_o", (cx, cy, OUTLINE_H / 2), (fw + 2 * OUTLINE_RING, fd + 2 * OUTLINE_RING, OUTLINE_H),
detail: README says footprint+~0.03, spec says footprint+~0.06; the code is 0.03 per side (plate = footprint+0.06 overall). Both tables are labeled 'must match or the pass is rejected at fold-in' — a Blender pass following one doc doubles the other's ring.
recommended_fix: Pick one convention and state it in both tables, e.g. 'outline ring 0.03 per side (plate = footprint + 0.06 overall)', matching OUTLINE_RING=0.03 and add_outline.

title: Contract pins 'ORTHO ~66° tilt' but aim()'s elevation varies per-sprite-pad from ~47° to ~65°
evidence:
assets/blender/README.md:23:
| Camera | ORTHO, ~66° tilt — the roof carries the read, thin outline visible all around |

docs/silhouette-spec.md:26:
| Camera | ORTHO, ~66° tilt (roof carries the read, thin outline visible all around) | the MM top-down view (7.1 canon) |

tools/gen_sprites.py:140-142:
    cd.ortho_scale = 1.9 * pad
    co.location = (0, -4.5 * pad, 10.0)
    direction = mathutils.Vector((0, 0.35, 0.10)) - mathutils.Vector(co.location)

tools/gen_sprites.py:325-331 pads: host/small_biz 1.20, dc 1.60, campus 1.95, puck 0.95 → elevation = atan(9.9/(0.35+4.5·pad)): puck ≈65°, house(1.12) ≈61°, host/small_biz ≈60°, dc ≈53°, campus ≈47°.
detail: Only the pucks render near 66°; campus deviates ~18°, dc ~13°. A Blender pass sculpted at '~66°' per the must-match contract produces different foreshortening than the code-driven fold-in render for 8 of 11 sprites. PR body's 'varies slightly' understates the spread.
recommended_fix: State the actual per-pad tilt (or the aim() formula and each family's pad/elevation) in README §Render contract and spec §0 instead of a single '~66°' value.
